bio.text: Vince George, a Democrat, won his party's nomination for U.S. House in West Virginia's 1st Congressional District in the May 12, 2026 primary, defeating Brit Aguirre, according to the Associated Press.
The AP describes George as a retired public servant, former teacher and community advocate from South Charleston.

sources.title: Vince George wins Democratic nod in US House District 1 race
